AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals? (1 mark)

   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
